title: What if Earth spun 17 times faster? 🌍
subject: earth
description:
Where would you run first? 👇

What would happen if Earth spun faster? At 100 mph extra the equator starts to flood, and at about 17,000 mph you would weigh nothing at the equator, with a day just 85 minutes long.

Sources: Popular Science ("What would happen if the Earth started to spin faster?", with NASA astronomer Sten Odenwald and Esri analyst Witold Fraczek); NASA Goddard, David P. Stern, "The Rotating Earth"
tags: what if earth spun 17 times faster

scenes.text: Spin Earth 17 times faster and you'd float away.
Right now the equator turns at 1,037 mph, so you already weigh a pound less there than in the Arctic.
Add just 100 mph and the oceans slide toward the middle. Esri analyst Witold Fraczek says the Amazon Basin would go under.
At 1,000 mph extra, only peaks like Kilimanjaro stay dry.
Near 17,000 mph, the spin cancels gravity. NASA's Sten Odenwald says you'd be essentially weightless, and a day would last 85 minutes.
